fields.title: Top 10 Tips for Your First Safari
fields.author: Sarah Johnson
fields.content: Planning your first African safari? Here are essential tips to make your experience unforgettable. First, pack neutral-colored clothing to blend in with the environment. Second, bring binoculars for better wildlife viewing. Third, always listen to your guide - they have invaluable local knowledge. Fourth, carry a good camera with zoom lens. Fifth, stay hydrated and protect yourself from the sun. Sixth, be patient - wildlife sightings require time. Seventh, respect the animals by maintaining safe distance. Eighth, keep noise levels down to not disturb wildlife. Ninth, ask questions - guides love sharing knowledge. Tenth, embrace the experience and create lasting memories!

fields.title: Complete Guide to the Great Migration
fields.author: Michael Otieno
fields.content: The Great Wildebeest Migration is one of nature's most spectacular events. Over 1.5 million wildebeest, along with hundreds of thousands of zebras and gazelles, travel in a continuous cycle across the Serengeti-Mara ecosystem. The best time to witness river crossings is between July and October. Key locations include the Mara River in Kenya and the Grumeti River in Tanzania. For photography, early morning light provides the best conditions. Remember to book accommodations well in advance as this is peak season. A hot air balloon safari offers the most breathtaking aerial views of the migration.

fields.title: Immersive Cultural Experiences in Kenya
fields.author: Grace Mwangi
fields.content: Beyond wildlife, Kenya offers rich cultural experiences that connect you with local communities. Visit a traditional Maasai village to learn about their customs, jumping dances, and sustainable practices. Try authentic Kenyan dishes like ugali, nyama choma, and sukuma wiki. Visit local markets in Nairobi for handmade crafts and jewelry. The Bomas of Kenya showcases traditional music and dance from various tribes. Remember to ask permission before taking photos of people, and support community-based tourism initiatives that directly benefit local families.

fields.title: Best Photography Spots in Serengeti
fields.author: James Kamau
fields.content: The Serengeti offers incredible photography opportunities. Top spots include: Retina Hippo Pool for close-up hippo shots, Moru Kopjes for lion sightings against rocky backdrops, Seronera River for year-round wildlife, and the Ndutu area for calving season (January-February). For sunrise photos, position yourself facing east near the Simba Kopjes. Use a lens with at least 200-400mm reach for wildlife. Golden hour (just after sunrise and before sunset) provides the most dramatic lighting. Always prioritize safety over getting the perfect shot.

fields.title: Packing Essentials for East Africa Safari
fields.author: Lisa Anderson
fields.content: Packing smart can make or break your safari experience. Essential items include: lightweight neutral-colored clothing (avoid white and black), comfortable walking shoes, wide-brimmed hat, sunglasses, high-SPF sunscreen, insect repellent with DEET, binoculars, camera with extra batteries and memory cards, power bank, basic first-aid kit, prescription medications, reusable water bottle, and a daypack for game drives. Don't forget a warm jacket for early morning drives - it can get surprisingly chilly! Laundry services are available at most lodges, so you don't need to pack for every day.

fields.title: Conservation Success Stories in East Africa
fields.author: Dr. Richard Leakey
fields.content: East Africa has seen remarkable conservation successes. Elephant populations in Kenya have more than doubled since the 1980s thanks to anti-poaching efforts. The mountain gorilla population in Uganda and Rwanda has increased by 25% in the last decade. Community conservancies in northern Kenya have created wildlife corridors that benefit both animals and local people. The banning of plastic bags in Kenya and Rwanda has significantly reduced environmental pollution. These successes show that with political will and community involvement, we can protect Africa's natural heritage for future generations.

fields.name: Uganda Gorilla & Chimpanzee Trek
fields.description: Track mountain gorillas in Bwindi and chimpanzees in Kibale Forest. Includes permits and expert trackers.

fields.name: Zanzibar & Ngorongoro Explorer

fields.description: Flamingos at Lake Nakuru and elephants with Kilimanjaro views in Amboseli. Ideal for families.

fields.description: Gorilla trekking in Uganda and golden monkey tracking in Rwanda. Cultural village visits included.

fields.name: Victoria Falls & Kruger Combo

fields.name: Cape Winelands & Wildlife Escape

fields.name: Ghana Castles & Culture Tour
fields.description: Explore slave castles, Kakum canopy walkway, and vibrant Ashanti culture.

fields.name: Senegal Dakar & Sine Saloum Delta
fields.description: Pink Lake, Goree Island, and birdwatching in the mangrove delta.

fields.name: Benin Togo Voodoo & Culture
fields.description: Immerse in voodoo traditions, markets, and coastal villages of Benin and Togo.

fields.name: Ivory Coast Highlights

fields.name: Nigeria Yoruba & Lagos Experience
fields.description: Lagos vibrancy, Osun-Osogbo Sacred Grove, and Yoruba cultural heritage.

fields.name: Egypt Nile Cruise & Pyramids

fields.name: Morocco Imperial Cities

fields.name: Botswana Okavango Delta Fly-In

fields.name: Namibia Desert & Wildlife
fields.description: Sossusvlei dunes, Etosha National Park, and Swakopmund coastal adventure.

fields.name: Madagascar Lemurs & Baobabs
fields.description: Unique wildlife, Avenue of Baobabs, and beach relaxation in Nosy Be.

fields.name: Dubai Desert & City Escape
fields.description: Burj Khalifa, desert safari with dune bashing, and luxury shopping.

fields.name: Turkey Istanbul & Cappadocia
fields.description: Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, and hot air balloon over fairy chimneys.

fields.name: Thailand Bangkok & Phuket
fields.description: Temples, markets, and beautiful beaches in Phuket.

fields.name: India Golden Triangle

fields.name: Europe Paris & Rome Highlights
fields.description: Eiffel Tower, Louvre, Colosseum, and Vatican.

fields.name: Indian Ocean Island Cruise

fields.name: Mediterranean African Shores

fields.name: South Africa Coastal Cruise

fields.name: West Africa Discovery Cruise

fields.name: Japan & Korea Cruise Adventure 2027
fields.description:
Experience an unforgettable 7-night luxury cruise adventure through some of the world's most iconic destinations aboard the Norwegian Epic. Enjoy world-class dining, premium entertainment, comfortable accommodations, and breathtaking ocean views throughout your journey.

This cruise package offers a perfect blend of relaxation, culture, and exploration, making it ideal for couples, families, and adventure seekers. Sail in style while creating memories that will last a lifetime.

Package Highlights:
• Luxury accommodation onboard Norwegian Epic
• Main dining and buffet meals included
• Onboard entertainment and activities
• Port-to-port sailing experience
• Basic beverages (tea, coffee, and water)
• Professional cruise services

fields.name: Norwegian Prima Northern Europe Cruise 2027
fields.description:
Embark on an extraordinary 10-night Northern Europe voyage aboard the award-winning Norwegian Prima. Explore charming European cities, majestic Norwegian fjords, and Iceland's stunning landscapes while enjoying world-class hospitality and luxurious accommodations.

This cruise is designed for travelers seeking breathtaking scenery, cultural experiences, and unforgettable adventures across Northern Europe.
Cruise Highlights

• Luxury accommodation aboard Norwegian Prima
• Spectacular Norwegian fjord cruising
• Visits to England, Belgium, Netherlands, Norway, and Iceland
• Premium dining experiences
• Entertainment and recreational facilities
• Modern ship amenities and comfort
• Incredible photography opportunities

fields.title: Arrival in Nairobi - Welcome to Kenya
fields.description: Arrive at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport (NBO). Meet your safari guide and transfer to your hotel in Nairobi. Evening briefing about your 8-day migration safari across Kenya and Tanzania. Overnight at a luxury hotel with pool and spa facilities.
fields.activities: Airport transfer, Welcome briefing, Rest and relaxation
fields.accommodation: 5-star hotel in Nairobi (Sarova Stanley or similar)

fields.title: Nairobi to Masai Mara - The Journey Begins
fields.description: Depart Nairobi at 7:00 AM. Drive through the Great Rift Valley with a photo stop at the viewpoint (2,200m altitude). Continue through the Loita Plains arriving at Masai Mara by 1:00 PM. Check-in at your luxury tented camp. Afternoon game drive from 3:30 PM to 6:30 PM to spot lions, elephants, and giraffes in the golden savannah light.
fields.activities: Scenic drive, Great Rift Valley photography, Afternoon game drive
fields.accommodation: Luxury tented camp in Masai Mara (Mara Serena or similar)

fields.title: Masai Mara - Full Day Migration Safari
fields.description: Early breakfast at 6:00 AM. Depart with packed lunch for a full day exploring the Mara River region. Witness the Great Migration (July-October) where thousands of wildebeest and zebras cross the crocodile-infested Mara River. Enjoy a picnic lunch at the riverbank. Continue game drive until 5:00 PM searching for the Big Five.
fields.activities: Full day game drive (8+ hours), River crossing viewing, Picnic lunch in the bush
fields.accommodation: Luxury tented camp in Masai Mara

fields.title: Masai Mara - Optional Balloon Safari & Maasai Village
fields.description: 4:00 AM optional hot air balloon safari ($480) with champagne breakfast in the bush. 9:00 AM morning game drive. Afternoon visit to a traditional Maasai village to learn about their culture, jumping dance, and traditional medicine. Evening sunset game drive.
fields.activities: Balloon safari (optional), Maasai village cultural visit, Sunset game drive
fields.accommodation: Luxury tented camp in Masai Mara

fields.title: Masai Mara to Serengeti - Border Crossing
fields.description: 6:00 AM early morning game drive. Return for breakfast and checkout. Drive to the Kenya-Tanzania border at Isebania. Complete immigration formalities. Meet your Tanzanian guide and continue to the Serengeti National Park. Afternoon game drive in the Seronera Valley known for its lion and leopard populations.
fields.activities: Early morning game drive, Border crossing, Afternoon game drive in Serengeti
fields.accommodation: Serengeti luxury lodge (Serengeti Serena or similar)

fields.title: Serengeti - Central Region Game Drives
fields.description: Full day exploring the central Serengeti. Search for leopards in the acacia trees along the Seronera River. See hippos and crocodiles at the hippo pool. Visit the Retina Hippo Pool for lunch. Afternoon game drive following predator tracks. Spot cheetahs on the open plains.
fields.activities: Full day game drive, Hippo pool visit, Big Cat tracking

fields.title: Serengeti to Ngorongoro Conservation Area
fields.description: Morning game drive in Serengeti. Drive to Ngorongoro Conservation Area via the Olduvai Gorge, the "Cradle of Mankind" museum (entry included). Learn about early human fossils. Descend into the Ngorongoro Crater rim for overnight with stunning views of the world's largest caldera.
fields.activities: Morning game drive, Olduvai Gorge museum tour, Crater rim views
fields.accommodation: Ngorongoro Crater rim lodge (Ngorongoro Serena or similar)

fields.title: Ngorongoro Crater Game Drive - Return to Arusha
fields.description: 5:30 AM early descent into the Ngorongoro Crater floor (600m descent). Game drive in the crater searching for the Big Five - lions, elephants, buffalo, rhinos, and leopards. Picnic lunch at the hippo pool near the lake. Ascend the crater and drive to Arusha. Drop-off at Kilimanjaro Airport (JRO) for departure or Arusha hotel.
fields.activities: Crater floor game drive, Hippo pool picnic, Scenic drive to Arusha

fields.title: Arrival in Entebbe - Welcome to Uganda
fields.description: Arrive at Entebbe International Airport (EBB). Meet your guide and transfer to your hotel. Briefing about your primate adventure. Evening relaxation at the hotel with views of Lake Victoria, Africa's largest lake.
fields.activities: Airport transfer, Welcome briefing, Lake Victoria views
fields.accommodation: Lake Victoria hotel (Lake Victoria Serena or similar)

fields.title: Entebbe to Kibale Forest - The Chimpanzee Journey
fields.description: 7:00 AM breakfast and briefing. Drive to Kibale National Park (6 hours) through the beautiful Ugandan countryside with tea plantations and crater lakes. Arrive at Kibale Forest Lodge in the afternoon. Evening briefing from park rangers about chimpanzee trekking guidelines.
fields.activities: Scenic drive, Tea plantation views, Chimpanzee trek briefing
fields.accommodation: Kibale Forest Lodge (Primate Lodge or similar)

fields.title: Chimpanzee Trekking in Kibale Forest
fields.description: 6:30 AM breakfast and packing. 7:30 AM depart for park headquarters for briefing. Enter Kibale Forest for chimpanzee trekking (2-5 hours). Once located, spend one hour observing chimpanzees as they feed, play, and socialize. Learn about their social structures from expert trackers. Afternoon visit to Bigodi Wetland Sanctuary for bird watching.
fields.activities: Chimpanzee trekking, Photography, Bigodi Wetland bird walk

fields.title: Kibale to Bwindi - Through the Mountains
fields.description: 8:00 AM breakfast. Drive to Bwindi Impenetrable National Park (5-6 hours) via Queen Elizabeth National Park with views of the Rwenzori Mountains. Check-in at your Bwindi lodge nestled in the jungle. Evening briefing about gorilla trekking rules and safety.
fields.activities: Scenic mountain drive, Wildlife viewing en route, Gorilla trek briefing
fields.accommodation: Bwindi Jungle Lodge (Bwindi Lodge or similar)

fields.title: Gorilla Trekking in Bwindi Impenetrable Forest
fields.description: 5:30 AM early breakfast. Drive to park headquarters for gorilla group assignment. Enter Bwindi's dense forest with expert trackers and armed guards. Trek through thick vegetation (1-5 hours depending on gorilla location). Once you find a gorilla family, you have one magical hour watching them eat, play, and interact. Return to lodge for celebration lunch.
fields.activities: Gorilla trekking (habituation experience), Photography, Celebration lunch

fields.title: Bwindi to Entebbe - Departure
fields.description: 7:00 AM breakfast. Morning optional Batwa pygmy cultural experience (visit the "Keepers of the Forest" to learn about their traditional forest life). Drive back to Entebbe (7-8 hours) with packed lunch. Stop at the Equator for photo opportunity. Evening drop-off at Entebbe Airport for departure.
fields.activities: Batwa cultural visit (optional), Equator crossing, Scenic return drive

fields.title: Arrival in Arusha - Gateway to Safaris
fields.description: Arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) or Arusha Airport (ARK). Meet your guide and transfer to your hotel in Arusha, the safari capital of Tanzania. Evening briefing about your upcoming Ngorongoro safari.
fields.activities: Airport transfer, Welcome briefing, Rest and relaxation
fields.accommodation: 4-star hotel in Arusha (Arusha Serena or similar)

fields.title: Arusha to Ngorongoro - Crater Views
fields.description: 8:00 AM departure from Arusha. Drive through the Maasai steppe to Ngorongoro Conservation Area (3 hours). Arrive at your lodge perched on the crater rim (2,300m). Afternoon at leisure taking in the breathtaking views of the world's largest intact caldera. Sunset photography.
fields.activities: Scenic drive, Crater rim views, Sunset photography
fields.accommodation: Ngorongoro Crater rim lodge (Ngorongoro Serena or similar)

fields.title: Ngorongoro Crater Safari - The 8th Wonder
fields.description: 5:30 AM early breakfast. Descend 600 meters into the crater floor for a full day game drive (6-7 hours). Search for the Big Five - black rhinos, lions, elephants, buffalo, and leopards. Picnic lunch at the hippo pool near Lake Magadi. Spot flamingos on the soda lake. Ascend the crater by 5:00 PM.
fields.activities: Full day crater game drive, Hippo pool picnic, Flamingo viewing

fields.title: Maasai Village Visit - Transfer to Arusha
fields.description: 8:00 AM breakfast. Visit a traditional Maasai boma (village) to learn about their semi-nomadic lifestyle, jumping dance, and traditional medicine. Drive back to Arusha (3 hours). Afternoon at leisure. Evening flight to Zanzibar (1.5 hours). Arrive at Abeid Amani Karume International Airport (ZNZ). Transfer to your beach resort.
fields.activities: Maasai village cultural visit, Scenic drive, Domestic flight to Zanzibar
fields.accommodation: Beach resort in Zanzibar (Nungwi or Kendwa area)

fields.title: Zanzibar - Stone Town Spice Tour
fields.description: 8:00 AM breakfast. Transfer to Stone Town for a spice tour. Visit a spice plantation to see, smell, and taste exotic spices like cloves, nutmeg, cinnamon, and vanilla. Learn about their medicinal uses. Afternoon Stone Town walking tour - visit the House of Wonders, Arab Fort, Freddie Mercury Museum, and Darajani Market.
fields.activities: Spice plantation tour, Stone Town historical walking tour, Market visit

fields.title: Zanzibar - Prison Island & Nakupenda Sandbank
fields.description: 9:00 AM boat trip to Prison Island (Changuu Island). See giant Aldabra tortoises, some over 100 years old. Continue to Nakupenda Sandbank - a sandbar that emerges during low tide. Swim in crystal clear turquoise waters. Fresh seafood lunch on the sandbank. Snorkel among colorful tropical fish.
fields.activities: Boat cruise, Tortoise viewing, Sandbank lunch, Snorkeling

fields.title: Zanzibar - Jozani Forest & Beach Relaxation
fields.description: 9:00 AM visit Jozani Chwaka Bay National Park - the only national park in Zanzibar. Walk along boardwalks through mangrove forest. Spot the rare Red Colobus monkeys (endemic to Zanzibar). Return to resort. Afternoon free for beach activities - swimming, sunbathing, kayaking, or paddleboarding.
fields.activities: Jozani Forest walk, Red Colobus monkey viewing, Beach relaxation

fields.title: Zanzibar - Free Day / Optional Blue Safari
fields.description: Full day free for relaxation or optional Blue Safari (extra cost). The Blue Safari takes you to Menai Bay Conservation Area for dolphin watching, snorkeling at Kwale Island, and visiting a natural swimming pool. See starfish, sea cucumbers, and coral gardens. Option to relax at the resort pool or spa.
fields.activities: Beach relaxation, Optional Blue Safari (dolphins, snorkeling), Spa treatment

fields.title: Zanzibar - Departure
fields.description: Breakfast at the resort. Last chance to swim in the Indian Ocean or buy souvenirs at the local market. Check-out by 10:00 AM. Transfer to Zanzibar Airport for your departure flight. Optional add-on: extra days in Zanzibar or safari extension.
fields.activities: Beach morning, Souvenir shopping, Airport transfer

fields.title: Nairobi to Lake Nakuru - Flamingo Paradise
fields.description: 7:00 AM departure from Nairobi. Drive through the Rift Valley escarpment to Lake Nakuru National Park (3 hours). Check-in at your lodge. Afternoon game drive along the lake shore to see thousands of flamingos turning the lake pink. Spot white and black rhinos in the sanctuary. Look for tree-climbing lions.
fields.activities: Scenic drive, Flamingo viewing, Rhino sanctuary visit
fields.accommodation: Family-friendly lodge in Lake Nakuru (Sarova Lion Hill or similar)

fields.title: Lake Nakuru - Full Day Family Safari
fields.description: 7:00 AM breakfast. Full day exploring Lake Nakuru. Visit Baboon Cliff for panoramic views. Search for Rothschild giraffes, waterbucks, zebras, and buffalo. Picnic lunch at Makalia Falls. Afternoon game drive to spot leopards in the acacia forest. Return to lodge for swimming and family activities.
fields.activities: Full day game drive, Makalia Falls picnic, Family swimming

fields.title: Lake Nakuru to Amboseli - Journey to Kilimanjaro
fields.description: 8:00 AM breakfast. Drive to Amboseli National Park (6-7 hours) via Nairobi. Lunch en route. Arrive at Amboseli in the late afternoon with views of Mount Kilimanjaro (Africa's highest peak) emerging from the clouds. Evening game drive.
fields.activities: Scenic drive, Mount Kilimanjaro photography, Evening game drive
fields.accommodation: Amboseli family lodge (Amboseli Serena or similar)

fields.title: Amboseli - Elephants with Kilimanjaro Background
fields.description: 6:00 AM early morning game drive to photograph elephants against the snow-capped peak of Mount Kilimanjaro. Return to lodge for breakfast. Morning at leisure - swimming or cultural visit to a Maasai village. Afternoon game drive to Observation Hill for 360-degree views of the park and its swamps.
fields.activities: Early morning elephant photography, Maasai village visit (optional), Observation Hill climb

fields.title: Amboseli to Nairobi - Return Journey
fields.description: 6:30 AM final game drive in Amboseli. Return for breakfast and checkout. Drive back to Nairobi (4 hours) with lunch en route at a family-friendly restaurant. Arrive in Nairobi by 3:00 PM. Drop-off at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport or your Nairobi hotel.
fields.activities: Final game drive, Scenic return drive, Family photo review

fields.title: Arrival in Kigali - Land of a Thousand Hills
fields.description: Arrive at Kigali International Airport (KGL). Meet your guide and transfer to your hotel. Visit the Kigali Genocide Memorial for a sobering but important educational experience. Evening briefing about your primate adventure. Dinner at a local restaurant serving Rwandan cuisine.
fields.activities: Airport transfer, Genocide Memorial visit, Welcome briefing
fields.accommodation: 4-star hotel in Kigali (Kigali Serena or similar)

fields.title: Kigali to Volcanoes National Park - Golden Monkeys
fields.description: 7:00 AM breakfast. Drive to Musanze (2 hours). Check-in at your lodge at the foothills of the Virunga Mountains. Afternoon golden monkey trekking in Volcanoes National Park (2-3 hours). Spend one hour with these playful primates in the bamboo forest.
fields.activities: Scenic drive, Golden monkey trekking, Photography
fields.accommodation: Volcanoes mountain lodge (Virunga Lodge or similar)

fields.title: Volcanoes - Optional Gorilla Trek (Rwanda) or Cultural Day
fields.description: Option A (extra cost $1500): Gorilla trekking in Rwanda - early morning briefing and trek into the forest to find a mountain gorilla family. Option B: Visit Iby'Iwacu Cultural Village to learn about traditional Rwandan life - banana beer making, blacksmithing, and Intore dancing. Afternoon visit to Dian Fossey grave site.
fields.activities: Either Gorilla trekking OR Cultural village visit, Dian Fossey grave hike

fields.title: Volcanoes to Bwindi - Crossing to Uganda
fields.description: 8:00 AM breakfast. Drive to Cyanika border crossing into Uganda (1 hour). Complete immigration formalities. Continue to Bwindi Impenetrable National Park (3 hours) through the beautiful Kigezi Highlands - known as the "Switzerland of Africa". Check-in at your Bwindi lodge. Evening gorilla trek briefing.
fields.activities: Border crossing, Scenic highland drive, Gorilla trek briefing
fields.accommodation: Bwindi Jungle Lodge (Bwindi Lodge or similar)

fields.title: Gorilla Trekking in Bwindi - The Ultimate Experience
fields.description: 5:30 AM early breakfast. 6:30 AM depart for park headquarters. Meet your trackers and armed guards. Enter Bwindi's Impenetrable Forest. Trek 1-6 hours through thick vegetation, guided by trackers who communicate with gorillas. Once you find the gorilla family, you have one magical hour watching them. Return to lodge for celebration.
fields.activities: Gorilla trekking, Photography, Celebration dinner

fields.title: Bwindi - Batwa Cultural Experience
fields.description: 9:00 AM breakfast. Visit the Batwa pygmies - the "Keepers of the Forest". Learn their traditional hunting techniques, hear forest songs, and see how they lived in the forest before the park was gazetted. Participate in traditional dance. Afternoon optional community walk or relaxation at lodge.
fields.activities: Batwa cultural experience, Traditional dance, Forest walk

fields.title: Bwindi to Kigali - Departure
fields.description: 7:00 AM breakfast. Drive to the Uganda-Rwanda border at Cyanika (2 hours). Complete immigration. Continue to Kigali (2 hours). Lunch at a local restaurant in Kigali. Visit the Caplaki Craft Village for souvenir shopping. Drop-off at Kigali International Airport for departure.
fields.activities: Border crossing, Craft market shopping, Airport transfer

fields.title: Arrival in Cape Town - The Mother City
fields.description: Arrive at Cape Town International Airport (CPT). Meet your guide and transfer to your hotel in the V&A Waterfront area. Afternoon visit to Table Mountain (weather permitting) via cable car. 360-degree views of Cape Town, Robben Island, and the Atlantic Ocean. Evening welcome dinner.
fields.activities: Airport transfer, Table Mountain cable car, City views
fields.accommodation: 4-star hotel in V&A Waterfront (Cape Grace or similar)

fields.title: Cape Peninsula Tour - Cape of Good Hope
fields.description: 8:00 AM departure. Drive along Chapman's Peak Drive - one of the most scenic coastal roads. Visit Hout Bay for optional boat trip to Seal Island. Continue to Cape of Good Hope Nature Reserve - hike to the old lighthouse. Visit Boulders Beach to see African penguins. Return via Simon's Town.
fields.activities: Chapman's Peak Drive, Seal Island boat trip, Cape Point hike, Penguin viewing

fields.title: Stellenbosch Wine Tour - Cape Winelands
fields.description: 9:00 AM drive to Stellenbosch (45 minutes), South Africa's second oldest town. Visit 3-4 wine estates for tastings including at Spier, Delaire Graff, and Tokara. Learn about wine making and pair wines with local cheeses. Lunch at a vineyard restaurant. Afternoon explore Stellenbosch's oak-lined streets.
fields.activities: Wine tasting at 4 estates, Wine and cheese pairing, Stellenbosch town walk

fields.title: Cape Town to Kruger - Flight & Sunset Safari
fields.description: Morning flight from Cape Town to Kruger Mpumalanga International Airport (MQP) or Hoedspruit (HDS). Transfer to your Kruger lodge (1 hour). Check-in and lunch. Afternoon game drive (4:00 PM - 6:30 PM) in an open safari vehicle. See elephants, giraffes, zebras as the sun sets.
fields.activities: Domestic flight, Afternoon game drive, Sunset photography
fields.accommodation: Kruger luxury safari lodge (Kapama or similar)

fields.title: Kruger - Full Day Big Five Safari
fields.description: 5:30 AM early morning game drive to spot predators before they retreat. Return for breakfast. Morning at leisure - swimming or spa. Afternoon game drive (3:00 PM - 6:00 PM) to find the Big Five. Night drive option to see nocturnal animals like bushbabies, civets, and porcupines.
fields.activities: Early morning game drive, Afternoon game drive, Optional night drive

fields.title: Kruger - Bush Walk & Panorama Route
fields.description: 6:00 AM guided bush walk with armed rangers (2 hours) - learn about tracking, animal behavior, and indigenous plants. Breakfast. Drive the Panorama Route to see Blyde River Canyon (3rd largest canyon in the world), Bourke's Luck Potholes, and God's Window. Return to lodge.
fields.activities: Guided bush walk, Blyde River Canyon views, God's Window viewpoint

fields.title: Kruger to Johannesburg - Departure
fields.description: 6:00 AM final morning game drive. Return for breakfast. Transfer to Kruger Airport (1 hour). Flight to Johannesburg OR Tambo International Airport (JNB). Connect to your international departure flight.
fields.activities: Final game drive, Airport transfers, Flight connections

fields.title: Cape Town to Hermanus - Whale Watching Capital
fields.description: Pick up your rental 4x4 vehicle in Cape Town. Drive to Hermanus (2 hours) - the best land-based whale watching in the world (June-Nov). Check-in at guest house. Afternoon Cliff Path walk to see Southern Right whales breaching. Evening seafood dinner at the harbour.
fields.activities: Car rental pickup, Scenic coastal drive, Whale watching walk

fields.title: Hermanus to Mossel Bay - Coastal Beauty
fields.description: 9:00 AM depart Hermanus. Drive through the Overberg region. Visit Stony Point Nature Reserve to see African penguins. Stop in Stanford for craft beer tasting. Continue to Mossel Bay (3 hours total drive). Visit the Bartolomeu Dias Museum complex (first European landing site).
fields.activities: Penguin viewing, Craft beer tasting, Historic museum visit

fields.title: Mossel Bay to Knysna - Oyster Town
fields.description: Drive to Knysna (1.5 hours). Stop at the Post Office Tree (ancient mail tree). Visit Knysna Heads viewpoints. Afternoon Knysna Lagoon boat cruise to see the famous Knysna Heads entrance. Visit Thesen Island for craft shops and galleries. Oyster tasting at the waterfront.
fields.activities: Knysna Heads photography, Lagoon boat cruise, Oyster tasting

fields.title: Knysna - Free Day / Optional Activities
fields.description: Free day to explore Knysna. Options include: 1) Featherbed Nature Reserve (boat trip & hike), 2) Knysna Elephant Park (walk with rescued elephants), 3) Simola Golf Course, 4) Brenton-on-Sea beach. Evening sunset drive along the lagoon.
fields.activities: Choice of activities: Elephant experience, Hiking, Beach, Golf

fields.title: Knysna to Plettenberg Bay via Tsitsikamma
fields.description: Drive to Tsitsikamma National Park (1 hour). Walk the suspension bridge over Storms River Mouth. Optional activities: Treetop canopy tour, bungee jumping from Bloukrans Bridge (216m - highest in Africa). Continue to Plettenberg Bay (30 minutes). Visit Robberg Nature Reserve hike.
fields.activities: Suspension bridge walk, Canopy tour (optional), Robberg hike

fields.title: Plettenberg Bay to Addo Elephant Park
fields.description: Morning free for beach or Robberg hike. Drive to Addo Elephant National Park (2.5 hours). Check-in at lodge. Afternoon game drive in Addo to see the Big Seven - elephants, lions, buffalo, rhinos, leopards, and marine mammals (Great White Sharks and Southern Right Whales).
fields.activities: Beach morning, Afternoon game drive in Addo, Elephant viewing

fields.title: Addo Elephant Park - Full Day Safari
fields.description: Full day game drive in Addo. Early morning drive to see predators. Explore the northern section for lions and hyenas. Picnic lunch at Jack's Picnic Site. Afternoon drive to the southern section for buffalo and antelope. Return to lodge at sunset.
fields.activities: Full day game drive, Predator tracking, Picnic lunch in the bush

fields.title: Addo to Port Elizabeth - Return & Departure
fields.description: Early morning game drive (optional). Breakfast and checkout. Drive to Port Elizabeth (1 hour). Stop at Cape Recife Lighthouse. Drop off rental car at Port Elizabeth Airport (PLZ). Connect to your flight to Johannesburg or Cape Town for departure.
fields.activities: Optional morning drive, Car return, Airport transfer

fields.title: Arrival in Sabi Sands - Luxury Welcome
fields.description: Fly from Johannesburg OR Tambo Airport (JNB) to Ulusaba Airstrip (1 hour) or drive (5 hours). Land at your exclusive lodge on a private airstrip. Welcome drink and check-in. Afternoon high tea followed by game drive (4:00 PM - 7:00 PM). Search for leopards - Sabi Sands is famous for them. Dinner under the stars.
fields.activities: Small plane flight, Welcome drink, Afternoon game drive, Stargazing dinner
fields.accommodation: Ultra-luxury lodge (Sabi Sabi, Londolozi, or Ulusaba)

fields.title: Sabi Sands - Leopard Tracking Day
fields.description: 5:30 AM wake-up call with coffee and rusks. Morning game drive (6:00 AM - 9:00 AM) - best time to see leopards hunting. Return for brunch. Afternoon at leisure - bush spa treatments, infinity pool, or photography lesson. Afternoon game drive (4:00 PM - 7:00 PM) with night drive component to see nocturnal animals.
fields.activities: Morning leopard tracking, Spa treatments, Afternoon/night game drive

fields.title: Sabi Sands - Full Safari Experience
fields.description: Option for full day safari with picnic breakfast and lunch in the bush. Visit different regions of Sabi Sands to see lions, elephants, and rhinos. Alternatively, enjoy the lodge amenities. Evening game drive followed by boma dinner (traditional African feast around a campfire).
fields.activities: Full day game drive OR lodge relaxation, Boma dinner experience

fields.title: Sabi Sands - Bush Walks & Photography
fields.description: Morning bush walk (2 hours) with armed rangers - track animals on foot, learn about medicinal plants, and animal tracks. Return for breakfast. Afternoon photography safari with guide who helps capture the perfect shot of lions and leopards. Sunset drinks at a scenic lookout point.
fields.activities: Guided bush walk, Photography safari, Sunset drinks

fields.title: Sabi Sands to Johannesburg - Departure
fields.description: Final morning game drive (6:00 AM - 8:00 AM). Return for gourmet breakfast. Check-out. Light aircraft transfer back to Johannesburg OR Tambo Airport (JNB). Connect to your international departure flight.
fields.activities: Final game drive, Light aircraft flight, Departure

fields.title: Arrival at Victoria Falls - Smoke that Thunders
fields.description: Arrive at Victoria Falls Airport (VFA) in Zimbabwe (or Livingstone Airport LVI in Zambia). Transfer to your hotel. Afternoon visit to Victoria Falls (entry included) - walk along the 1.7km trail with 16 viewpoints. Feel the spray from "Mosi-oa-Tunya" (The Smoke that Thunders).
fields.activities: Airport transfer, Victoria Falls walking tour, Photography
fields.accommodation: Victoria Falls luxury hotel (Victoria Falls Hotel or similar)

fields.title: Victoria Falls - Zambezi Sunset Cruise
fields.description: Morning free for optional activities - helicopter flight over the falls (15-25 minutes), bungee jumping off Victoria Falls Bridge (111m), or white water rafting on the Zambezi. Afternoon sunset cruise on the Zambezi River - see hippos, crocodiles, elephants, and birds. Complimentary drinks and snacks.
fields.activities: Optional adventure activities, Zambezi sunset cruise, Wildlife viewing

fields.title: Victoria Falls to Kruger - Flight Connection
fields.description: Morning visit to the Victoria Falls Bridge (border between Zimbabwe and Zambia). Walk to the Knife Edge Bridge for closer views. Optional Livingstone Island tour (swim in Devil's Pool - season dependent). Afternoon flight from Victoria Falls to Kruger (via Johannesburg, 3-4 hours). Transfer to your lodge.
fields.activities: Bridge walk, Optional Devil's Pool, Domestic flights

fields.title: Kruger - Big Five Safari Day 1
fields.description: 5:30 AM morning game drive in open vehicle. Search for the Big Five - focus on elephants and buffalo herds. Return for breakfast. Afternoon at leisure - swimming or bird watching. Afternoon game drive (3:30 PM - 6:30 PM) to spot lions on the prowl as the sun sets.
fields.activities: Morning game drive, Afternoon game drive, Relaxation

fields.title: Kruger - Big Five Safari Day 2
fields.description: Full day in Kruger National Park. Early morning departure. Drive into the park for a full day game viewing. Picnic lunch at a rest camp. Afternoon exploring different regions. Look for leopards in the Sabie River area and rhinos at waterholes.
fields.activities: Full day game drive, Picnic lunch, Bush exploration

fields.title: Kruger - Panorama Route Explorer
fields.description: Day trip to Panorama Route. Visit Blyde River Canyon (3rd largest canyon in the world). See Bourke's Luck Potholes where the Treur and Blyde rivers meet. God's Window viewpoint looking out over the lowveld. Lisbon Falls (second highest in South Africa).
fields.activities: Blyde River Canyon views, God's Window, Waterfall visit

fields.title: Kruger - Optional Walking Safari
fields.description: Morning guided bush walk with armed rangers (2-3 hours). Learn about tracking, animal behavior, and survival skills. Return for breakfast. Afternoon free for lodge activities - cooking class (African cuisine), wine tasting, or spa treatment. Evening night drive to see bushbabies, civets, and porcupines.
fields.activities: Guided bush walk, Cooking class or wine tasting, Night drive

fields.title: Kruger - Final Safari Day
fields.description: Morning game drive to catch predators returning from their night hunt. Breakfast. Visit local community project or village (optional). Afternoon free for last chance souvenir shopping at the lodge curio shop. Farewell dinner with traditional dancing.
fields.activities: Final game drive, Community visit (optional), Farewell dinner

fields.title: Kruger to Johannesburg - Departure
fields.description: Final morning game drive (optional). Breakfast and checkout. Transfer to Kruger Airport (1 hour). Flight to Johannesburg OR Tambo Airport (JNB). Connect to your international departure flight.
fields.activities: Optional final drive, Airport transfers, Departure

fields.title: Arrival in Cape Town to Stellenbosch
fields.description: Arrive at Cape Town International Airport (CPT). Pick up your luxury rental car. Drive to Stellenbosch (45 minutes). Check-in at a wine estate. Afternoon walk through Stellenbosch town - visit the Dutch Reformed Moederkerk, Dorp Street with its historic buildings, and Oom Samie se Winkel for curios.
fields.activities: Car rental pickup, Historic town walk, Wine estate check-in
fields.accommodation: Wine estate hotel in Stellenbosch (Lanzerac or similar)

fields.title: Stellenbosch - Premier Wine Estates
fields.description: 9:00 AM start wine tasting at some of Stellenbosch's top estates: Delaire Graff (art and architecture), Tokara (olive oil and wine), and Rust en Vrede (known for red blends). Lunch at a vineyard restaurant. Afternoon visit to the Village Museum (4 historic houses).
fields.activities: Wine tasting at 4 estates, Vineyard lunch, Museum visit

fields.title: Franschhoek - Wine Tram Experience
fields.description: Drive to Franschhoek (30 minutes) - the food and wine capital of South Africa. Board the Franschhoek Wine Tram - hop on hop off through 8 different wine estates. Visit La Motte (art gallery), Rickety Bridge, and Grande Provence (sculpture garden). Lunch option at the famous Franschhoek Beer Co.
fields.activities: Franschhoek Wine Tram, Art and sculpture viewing, Lunch at beer garden

fields.title: Stellenbosch to Hermanus - Whale Coast
fields.description: Morning breakfast. Drive to Hermanus (1.5 hours) via Sir Lowry's Pass with mountain views. Check into your guest house overlooking Walker Bay. Afternoon walk the Cliff Path (12km trail) - spot Southern Right Whales (June-Nov) from the shore. Visit the Old Harbour Museum.
fields.activities: Scenic mountain drive, Cliff Path whale watching, Harbour museum

fields.title: Hermanus - Whale Boat Safari & Gansbaai
fields.description: 9:00 AM boat-based whale watching tour (3 hours) - get up close to Southern Right Whales breaching and tail slapping. See dolphins, seals, and penguins. Afternoon drive to Gansbaai (30 minutes). Visit the Danger Point Lighthouse and viewpoint for great white shark viewing.
fields.activities: Whale watching boat tour, Dolphin viewing, Lighthouse visit

fields.title: Hermanus to Cape Town - Departure
fields.description: Morning free for last whale watching or visit the Hermanus Market (weekends). Drive back to Cape Town (1.5 hours) via Betty's Bay to see African penguins at Stony Point. Drop off rental car at Cape Town International Airport (CPT). Departure flight.
fields.activities: Penguin viewing, Scenic return drive, Car return

fields.title: Arrival in Accra - Welcome to Ghana
fields.description: Arrive at Kotoka International Airport (ACC). Meet your guide and transfer to your hotel. Evening visit to Osu Oxford Street for food, shopping, and nightlife. Sample local dishes like jollof rice and banku.
fields.activities: Airport transfer, Street food experience, Welcome briefing
fields.accommodation: 4-star hotel in Accra (Labadi Beach Hotel or similar)

fields.title: Accra City Tour & Kwame Nkrumah Memorial
fields.description: Morning Accra city tour. Visit the Kwame Nkrumah Mausoleum (first president of Ghana), W.E.B. Du Bois Centre, and Independence Square (Black Star Gate). Afternoon visit to Makola Market for local fabric and bead shopping. Evening drumming and dancing performance at the Arts Centre.
fields.activities: Historical monuments tour, Market shopping, Cultural performance

fields.title: Accra to Cape Coast - Slave Castles
fields.description: Drive to Cape Coast (3 hours). Visit Cape Coast Castle - a UNESCO World Heritage site and major departure point for enslaved Africans. Walk through the "Door of No Return". Afternoon visit to the Cape Coast Castle Museum and the nearby Posuban shrine (traditional Ashanti military structure).
fields.activities: Cape Coast Castle tour, Museum visit, Cultural shrine

fields.title: Elmina Castle & Kakum National Park
fields.description: Visit Elmina Castle (St. George's Castle) - the oldest European building in existence below the Sahara (built 1482). Learn about the Portuguese and Dutch colonial periods. Afternoon Kakum National Park - walk the Canopy Walkway (30 meters high, 350 meters long) through the rainforest. See monkeys, birds, and butterflies.
fields.activities: Elmina Castle history tour, Canopy walkway, Rainforest wildlife

fields.title: Cape Coast to Accra via Hans Cottage
fields.description: Morning visit to Hans Cottage Botel - see crocodiles and learn about West African wetlands. Visit the Posuban Shrine. Afternoon drive back to Accra. Stop at the fishing village of Senya Beraku to see traditional boat building. Evening free at your hotel.
fields.activities: Crocodile viewing, Boat building visit, Scenic return drive

fields.title: Accra Departure - Last Shopping
fields.description: Morning visit to the National Museum of Ghana (artifacts, gold weights, and Ghanaian art). Last chance shopping at the Global Mamas shop (fair trade crafts). Transfer to Kotoka International Airport for departure.
fields.activities: National Museum visit, Craft shopping, Airport transfer

fields.title: Arrival in Dakar - La Teranga
fields.description: Arrive at Blaise Diagne International Airport (DSS). Transfer to your hotel. Welcome briefing about Senegalese culture (Teranga means hospitality). Evening dinner at a restaurant overlooking the Atlantic Ocean.
fields.activities: Airport transfer, Welcome dinner, Ocean views
fields.accommodation: Ocean-view hotel in Dakar (Radisson Blu or similar)

fields.title: Dakar City Tour - African Renaissance
fields.description: Morning Dakar city tour. Visit the African Renaissance Monument (52m tall - tallest statue in Africa). See the Presidential Palace and Independence Square. Afternoon visit to the IFAN Museum of African Arts - one of the oldest museums in West Africa.
fields.activities: Monument visit, City landmarks, African art museum

fields.title: Goree Island - Door of No Return
fields.description: Morning ferry to Goree Island (20 minutes). Walk through the historic island with no cars. Visit the House of Slaves and the Door of No Return. See the colonial fort, colonial houses, and the Women's Museum. Afternoon return to Dakar. Visit the Sandaga Market.
fields.activities: Ferry crossing, Slave history tour, Market shopping

fields.title: Pink Lake (Lake Retba) - West African Wonder
fields.description: Drive to Lake Retba (1 hour) - known as the Pink Lake due to high salt content and Dunaliella salina algae. Take a boat ride on the pink water. See salt harvesters working in the lake (women collecting salt). Optional swim (you float like in the Dead Sea). Visit a local Wolof village.
fields.activities: Pink Lake boat ride, Salt harvesting viewing, Village visit

fields.title: Dakar to Sine Saloum Delta - Bird Paradise
fields.description: Drive to Sine Saloum Delta (3 hours) - a UNESCO World Heritage site. Check into your eco-lodge in the mangroves. Afternoon boat safari through the delta to see thousands of migratory birds (pelicans, flamingos, herons, kingfishers). Visit a shell island (islands made entirely of oyster shells).
fields.activities: Scenic drive, Birdwatching boat safari, Shell island exploration
fields.accommodation: Eco-lodge in Sine Saloum Delta (Les Palétuviers or similar)

fields.title: Sine Saloum Delta - Mangrove Kayaking
fields.description: Morning kayaking through the mangrove channels. Visit a Serer fishing village to learn about traditional fishing techniques. Lunch of fresh oysters and grilled fish. Afternoon visit to Fathala Wildlife Reserve (optional) to see giraffes, rhinos, and antelopes.
fields.activities: Mangrove kayaking, Village visit, Fathala game drive (optional)

fields.title: Sine Saloum to Dakar - Departure
fields.description: Morning birdwatching walk. Breakfast and checkout. Drive back to Dakar (3 hours). Last chance souvenir shopping at Soumbédioune Market (arts and crafts). Transfer to Blaise Diagne International Airport for departure.
fields.activities: Morning bird watching, Market shopping, Airport transfer

fields.title: Arrival in Cotonou, Benin - Gateway to Voodoo
fields.description: Arrive at Cadjehoun Airport (COO) in Cotonou. Meet your guide and transfer to your hotel. Evening visit to the Ganhi Market to see the vibrant atmosphere. Briefing about Voodoo culture, which is the official religion of Benin.
fields.activities: Airport transfer, Market visit, Cultural briefing

fields.title: Cotonou to Ouidah - Voodoo Heartland
fields.description: Drive to Ouidah (1 hour) - the spiritual capital of Voodoo. Visit the Python Temple where pythons are worshipped. Walk the Route des Esclaves (Slave Route) ending at the Door of No Return. Visit the Sacred Forest (forest of statues and fetishes). See the Zinsou Foundation art museum.
fields.activities: Python Temple visit, Slave Route walk, Sacred Forest tour
fields.accommodation: Hotel in Ouidah or return to Cotonou

fields.title: Ouidah - Voodoo Ceremony & Ganvie Lake Village
fields.description: Morning Voodoo ceremony (depending on day) with dancing, drumming, and trance performances. Learn about fetishes and spirits from a local Voodoo priest. Afternoon visit to Ganvie - the Venice of Africa. Take a boat to this stilt village built on Lake Nokoué with 20,000 inhabitants.
fields.activities: Voodoo ceremony experience, Ganvie boat tour, Stilt village walk

fields.title: Cotonou to Lome, Togo - Crossing Borders
fields.description: Drive to the Benin-Togo border at Hillacondji (1 hour). Complete immigration. Continue to Lome (1 hour). Visit the Grand Marché in Lome for fabric and crafts. Afternoon visit to the Togo National Museum to learn about Ewe culture.
fields.activities: Border crossing, Grand Marché shopping, National Museum visit
fields.accommodation: Hotel in Lome (Hotel Palm Beach or similar)

fields.title: Lome - Fetish Market & Akodessawa
fields.description: Morning visit to Akodessawa Fetish Market - the largest voodoo market in the world. See animal skulls, skins, bones, and potions. Learn how healers use these for traditional medicine. Afternoon visit to the German colonial cathedral and the Independence Monument.
fields.activities: Fetish market tour, Traditional medicine learning, Colonial architecture

fields.title: Lome to Kpalime - Togo Highlands
fields.description: Drive to Kpalime (2 hours) in the Plateaux Region of Togo. Visit traditional Ewe villages. See Mount Agou (Togo's highest peak). Visit a traditional weaving village to see Kente cloth being made. Afternoon hike to the Château Vial, a ruined colonial fort with views.
fields.activities: Scenic drive to highlands, Weaving village visit, Colonial fort hike

fields.title: Kpalime to Lome - Waterfalls & Markets
fields.description: Morning visit to Kpalime markets for local crafts including wood carvings. Visit the Womé Waterfalls (30 minute hike). Drive back to Lome (2 hours). Afternoon free for relaxation at the beach. Evening farewell dinner with traditional Togolese cuisine.
fields.activities: Craft market shopping, Waterfall hike, Beach relaxation

fields.title: Lome to Cotonou - Departure
fields.description: Morning drive back to Cotonou via the border (4 hours total). Last chance souvenir shopping at the Dantokpa Market - West Africa's largest open-air market. Transfer to Cadjehoun Airport for departure flight.
fields.activities: Border crossing, Dantokpa Market shopping, Airport transfer

fields.title: Arrival in Abidjan - Paris of Africa
fields.description: Arrive at Félix Houphouët-Boigny International Airport (ABJ). Transfer to your hotel. Evening visit to the Plateau district (central business district) for the city lights. Welcome dinner at a restaurant serving Ivorian cuisine.
fields.activities: Airport transfer, City lights tour, Welcome dinner
fields.accommodation: 4-star hotel in Abidjan (Hotel Tiama or similar)

fields.title: Abidjan City Tour - Modern Ivory Coast
fields.description: Morning Abidjan city tour. Visit St. Paul's Cathedral (designed by Aldo Spirito), the Presidential Palace, and the Banco National Park (urban rainforest). Afternoon visit to the Museum of Civilizations to see Baoulé art and Guro masks.
fields.activities: Cathedral visit, Rainforest walk, Museum tour

fields.title: Grand Bassam - Colonial Capital
fields.description: Drive to Grand Bassam (45 minutes) - UNESCO World Heritage site and former French colonial capital. Walking tour of the colonial quarter with its unique Creole architecture. Visit the Costume Museum and the colonial-era Governor's Palace. Afternoon at the beach.
fields.activities: Colonial architecture tour, Costume Museum, Beach time

fields.title: Abidjan to Tai National Park - Rainforest Adventure
fields.description: Drive to Tai National Park (8 hours) - one of West Africa's last primary rainforests (UNESCO site). Check into your eco-lodge. Evening briefing about the park's chimpanzees, pygmy hippos, and 1,300 plant species.
fields.activities: Long scenic drive, Rainforest arrival, Safety briefing

fields.title: Tai National Park - Chimpanzee Trekking
fields.description: Early morning breakfast. Enter the rainforest with expert guides for chimpanzee trekking (3-5 hours). Track the elusive West African chimpanzees (intelligent and shy). See colobus monkeys, duikers, and countless birds. Afternoon relaxation or community village visit.
fields.activities: Chimpanzee trekking, Rainforest hiking, Birdwatching

fields.title: Tai to Abidjan - Departure
fields.description: Morning forest walk to see plants and butterflies. Breakfast. Drive back to Abidjan (8 hours) with lunch en route. Transfer to Félix Houphouët-Boigny International Airport for departure.
fields.activities: Final rainforest walk, Scenic return drive, Airport transfer

fields.title: Arrival in Lagos - Africa's Giant
fields.description: Arrive at Murtala Muhammed International Airport (LOS). Transfer to your hotel. Evening visit to the Lekki Conservation Centre for a night walk on the canopy bridge. Feel the energy of Nigeria's largest city.
fields.activities: Airport transfer, Canopy bridge walk, City overview
fields.accommodation: Luxury hotel in Lagos (Eko Hotels or similar)

fields.title: Lagos City Tour - Rhythm of the City
fields.description: Morning Lagos city tour. Visit the National Museum (Benin bronzes, Nok terracottas). See the Freedom Park (former colonial prison). Visit the bustling Balogun Market and the Lekki Arts & Crafts Market. Afternoon visit to the Nike Art Gallery (largest gallery in West Africa).
fields.activities: National Museum tour, Market shopping, Art gallery visit

fields.title: Lagos to Osun-Osogbo - Sacred Grove
fields.description: Drive to Osogbo (4 hours). Visit the Osun-Osogbo Sacred Grove - a UNESCO World Heritage site and one of the last remaining sacred forests in Yoruba culture. Walk through the forest filled with shrines, sculptures, and art in honor of Osun (goddess of fertility).
fields.activities: Scenic drive, Sacred Grove walking tour, Yoruba history

fields.title: Osun-Osogbo Festival Preparations
fields.description: Learn about the annual Osun-Osogbo Festival (August). Visit the palace of the Ataoja of Osogbo to see the festival preparations. Walk through the grove again at sunrise. Visit traditional artisans making festival masks and costumes.
fields.activities: Festival learning, Sunrise grove walk, Artisan visit

fields.title: Osun-Osogbo to Lagos via Abeokuta
fields.description: Drive to Abeokuta (3 hours) - capital of Ogun State. Visit the Olumo Rock - climb the 137m rock for panoramic views. See the Alake's Palace (traditional ruler's palace). Drive back to Lagos (2 hours). Evening Nigerian-style with jollof rice and suya.
fields.activities: Olumo Rock climbing, Palace visit, Nigerian food tasting

fields.title: Lagos - Makoko Floating Village
fields.description: Morning boat trip to Makoko - the famous floating village of Lagos. See homes, schools, and markets built on stilts over the lagoon. Learn about the Egun people's unique lifestyle. Afternoon visit to the Slave Museum in Badagry (former slave port).
fields.activities: Makoko boat tour, Floating village visit, Slave Museum

fields.title: Lagos Departure - Last Lagos Vibe
fields.description: Morning visit to the Lekki Market for last-minute shopping (African prints, beads, and crafts). Optional Fela Shrine visit (Afrobeat museum). Transfer to Murtala Muhammed International Airport for departure.
fields.activities: Shopping, Afrobeat culture, Airport transfer

fields.title: Arrival in Cairo - Land of Pharaohs
fields.description: Arrive at Cairo International Airport (CAI). Meet your guide and transfer to your hotel. Evening welcome briefing. Optional visit to a local coffee shop for mint tea and shisha.
fields.activities: Airport transfer, Welcome briefing
fields.accommodation: 5-star hotel in Cairo (Marriott Mena House or similar)

fields.title: Giza Pyramids & Sphinx - Ancient Wonders
fields.description: Full day at Giza Plateau. Visit the Great Pyramid of Khufu, Pyramid of Khafre, and Pyramid of Menkaure. Optional entry inside the Great Pyramid. See the Great Sphinx and the Valley Temple. Evening Sound and Light Show at the Pyramids.
fields.activities: Pyramid exploration, Sphinx photography, Optional camel ride

fields.title: Egyptian Museum & Islamic Cairo
fields.description: Morning at the Egyptian Museum (Tutankhamun treasures, royal mummies room). Afternoon Coptic Cairo - visit the Hanging Church, Ben Ezra Synagogue, and Coptic Museum. Continue to Islamic Cairo - Alabaster Mosque of Muhammad Ali and Khan el-Khalili Bazaar.
fields.activities: Museum tour, Religious sites, Bazaar shopping

fields.title: Cairo to Luxor - Nile Cruise Embarkation
fields.description: Morning flight to Luxor (1 hour). Visit Karnak Temple Complex (largest religious building ever built). Embark on your 5-star Nile cruise ship. Afternoon visit to Luxor Temple illuminated at night.
fields.activities: Domestic flight, Karnak Temple tour, Luxor Temple at night

fields.title: Valley of the Kings & Hatshepsut Temple
fields.description: Early morning crossing to West Bank. Visit Valley of the Kings (entry to 3 tombs included - Tutankhamun separate). See Temple of Hatshepsut (Egypt's only female pharaoh). Visit the Colossi of Memnon. Afternoon sail to Edfu via Esna Lock.
fields.activities: Tomb exploration, Temple visits, Nile cruising

fields.title: Edfu Temple & Kom Ombo - Double Temple
fields.description: Early morning horse-drawn carriage to Temple of Edfu (best-preserved temple in Egypt). Sail to Kom Ombo. Afternoon visit Kom Ombo Temple (dedicated to two gods - Sobek the crocodile god and Haroeris). Visit the Crocodile Museum.
fields.activities: Horse carriage ride, Temple of Edfu, Kom Ombo Temple

fields.title: Aswan - High Dam & Philae Temple
fields.description: Arrive in Aswan. Visit the High Dam (modern engineering marvel). Take a motorboat to Philae Temple (dedicated to Isis - moved from original island). Afternoon optional tour to Abu Simbel (must pre-book). Evening Nubian village visit.
fields.activities: High Dam tour, Temple boat ride, Nubian cultural experience

fields.title: Aswan to Cairo - Departure
fields.description: Disembark cruise. Visit the Unfinished Obelisk (largest ancient obelisk). Flight back to Cairo (1.5 hours). Transfer to Cairo International Airport for departure.
fields.activities: Unfinished Obelisk, Domestic flight, International departure

fields.title: Arrival in Marrakech - Red City
fields.description: Arrive at Marrakech Menara Airport (RAK). Transfer to your riad in the medina. Evening walk through Jemaa el-Fnaa square to see snake charmers, storytellers, and food stalls.
fields.activities: Airport transfer, Medina introduction, Square experience

fields.title: Marrakech - Palaces & Gardens
fields.description: Morning visit to Bahia Palace, El Badi Palace ruins, and Saadian Tombs. Afternoon Jardin Majorelle (Yves Saint Laurent garden) and the new YSL Museum. Visit the souks for shopping (rugs, lamps, spices, leather).
fields.activities: Palace tours, Garden walk, Souk shopping

fields.title: Marrakech to Fes via Atlas Mountains
fields.description: Cross the High Atlas Mountains via Tizi n'Tichka Pass (2,260m). Visit Aït Ben Haddou (UNESCO fortress used in Game of Thrones). Continue to Ouarzazate (Hollywood of Africa). Arrive in Fes (8 hour scenic drive).
fields.activities: Mountain drive, Kasbah visit, Filmmaking studio tour

fields.title: Fes - Medieval Medina
fields.description: Full day exploring Fes el-Bali (largest car-free urban area in the world). Visit the tanneries, Bou Inania Madrasa, University of Al Quaraouiyine (oldest university), and the Nejjarine Museum of Wood Arts. Watch craftsmen working with metal, wood, and leather.
fields.activities: Medina walking tour, Tanneries visit, Craft workshops

fields.title: Fes to Merzouga - Sahara Camel Trek
fields.description: Drive to Merzouga (7 hours) through the Middle Atlas mountains with cedar forests. Arrive at the Sahara Desert. Switch to 4x4 to your desert camp. Evening camel trek to watch sunset over the dunes. Berber drumming around the campfire.
fields.activities: Scenic drive, Camel trek, Desert sunset, Star gazing

fields.title: Merzouga to Marrakech - Desert to City
fields.description: Early morning camel trek to watch sunrise. Breakfast at camp. Drive back to Marrakech (9 hours) via the Road of a Thousand Kasbahs. Stop at Dades Valley and Roses Valley. Overnight in Marrakech.
fields.activities: Sunrise camel trek, Valley views, Scenic return drive

fields.title: Marrakech Departure - Last Souk Adventure
fields.description: Free morning for final shopping at the souks or visit a hammam (traditional bathhouse). Transfer to Marrakech Menara Airport for departure.
fields.activities: Shopping, Hammam experience (optional), Airport transfer

fields.title: Arrival in Maun - Gateway to the Delta
fields.description: Arrive at Maun Airport (MUB). Take a light aircraft scenic flight over the Okavango Delta (included). See the patchwork of waterways, islands, and floodplains from above. Land at your exclusive luxury camp. Welcome drink and briefing.
fields.activities: Light aircraft transfer, Aerial delta views, Camp check-in
fields.accommodation: Luxury Delta Camp (Belmond or Sanctuary Retreats)

fields.title: Okavango Delta - Mokoro Safari
fields.description: Morning mokoro (traditional dugout canoe) safari through the crystal clear waterways. Your poler guide navigates through lilies and reeds. See elephants, hippos, and waterbucks drinking. Return to camp for lunch. Afternoon guided walking safari on a remote island.
fields.activities: Mokoro canoe ride, Water game viewing, Island walking safari

fields.title: Okavango Delta - Game Drives
fields.description: Morning game drive in open 4x4 vehicles. Search for lions, leopards, and African wild dogs. Afternoon at leisure - photography from the camp hide or dip in the plunge pool. Evening game drive to see nocturnal animals (genets, civets, porcupines).
fields.activities: Morning game drive, Hide photography, Evening night drive

fields.title: Okavango Delta - Boat Safari
fields.description: Full day exploring by motorboat. Navigate deeper channels to see more wildlife. Watch elephants swimming between islands. Picnic lunch on a remote island. Afternoon fishing for tilapia and catfish (catch and release).
fields.activities: Motorboat safari, Elephant swimming viewing, Fishing

fields.title: Okavango Delta - Helicopter Flip (Optional)
fields.description: Morning guided walk or optional helicopter flight over the Delta ($500 extra). See pods of hippos from above. Afternoon mokoro safari to a different part of the delta. Evening sundowner drinks overlooking the floodplain.
fields.activities: Helicopter flip (optional), Final mokoro ride, Sundowners

fields.title: Okavango Delta to Maun - Departure
fields.description: Final morning game drive or bush breakfast. Light aircraft transfer back to Maun. Connect to your onward flight from Maun Airport.
fields.activities: Final game drive, Light aircraft flight, Departure

fields.title: Arrival in Windhoek - Capital City
fields.description: Arrive at Hosea Kutako International Airport (WDH). Drive to Windhoek (45 minutes). Check into your hotel. Visit the Christuskirche, Tintenpalast (Parliament Building), and the Old Fortress. Evening at Joe's Beerhouse for Namibian cuisine.
fields.activities: Airport transfer, City orientation, Welcome dinner

fields.title: Windhoek to Sossusvlei - Desert Journey
fields.description: Drive to Sesriem (5 hours) through the Namib-Naukluft National Park. Check into desert lodge. Afternoon sunset viewing at Elim Dune. Watch the colors change on the dunes.
fields.activities: Scenic desert drive, Sunset photography

fields.title: Sossusvlei - Climb Big Daddy Dune
fields.description: 4:30 AM early departure to catch sunrise at the dunes. Climb Dune 45 (85m) and then Big Daddy Dune (325m - highest in the area). Walk to Deadvlei - white clay pan with dead camel thorn trees. Visit Hiddenvlei. Return to lodge for breakfast.
fields.activities: Sunrise dune climbing, Deadvlei photography, Sesriem Canyon visit

fields.title: Sossusvlei to Swakopmund - Coastal Town
fields.description: Drive to Walvis Bay (5 hours). See the stark change from desert to ocean. Visit Sandwich Harbour (4x4 required) - where dunes meet the sea. See flamingos at the Walvis Bay Lagoon. Continue to Swakopmund (30 minutes).
fields.activities: Desert to ocean drive, Sandwich Harbour tour, Flamingo viewing
fields.accommodation: Hotel in Swakopmund (Strand Hotel or similar)

fields.title: Swakopmund - Adventure Capital
fields.description: Day at leisure in Swakopmund. Optional activities: sandboarding down dunes, quad biking, sky diving, or fishing. Visit the Kristall Galerie (largest quartz crystal) and the Swakopmund Museum. Evening German-style dinner.
fields.activities: Choice of adventure activities, Museum visit, German cuisine

fields.title: Swakopmund to Etosha - Wildlife Safari
fields.description: Drive to Etosha National Park (6 hours). Enter the park via Anderson Gate. Afternoon game drive to Okaukuejo waterhole (famous for wildlife). Check into your lodge.
fields.activities: Scenic drive, Afternoon game drive, Night waterhole viewing

fields.title: Etosha - Full Day Safari
fields.description: Full day game drive across Etosha. Morning drive east to Halali resort. See elephants at the waterholes. Picnic lunch at a rest camp. Afternoon drive focusing on lions and giraffes. Return to lodge at sunset.
fields.activities: Full day game drive, Waterhole wildlife viewing, Bird watching

fields.title: Etosha - Final Safari Day
fields.description: Morning drive to the eastern sector of Etosha (Namutoni area). Visit Fischer's Pan to see springbok and zebra. Afternoon return to lodge. Evening night game drive (with spotlights) to see leopards and hyenas.
fields.activities: Morning game drive, Night safari, Star photography

fields.title: Etosha to Windhoek - Departure
fields.description: Final morning game drive. Breakfast and checkout. Drive back to Windhoek (5 hours). Stop at craft markets for souvenirs. Transfer to Hosea Kutako International Airport for departure.
fields.activities: Final game drive, Craft shopping, Airport transfer

fields.title: Arrival in Antananarivo - Highland Capital
fields.description: Arrive at Ivato International Airport (TNR). Transfer to your hotel in the upper town. Evening panoramic view of the city from Queen's Palace hill. Welcome briefing about Madagascar's unique biodiversity (90% endemic species).
fields.activities: Airport transfer, City viewpoint, Welcome briefing
fields.accommodation: Hotel in Antananarivo (Palissandre Hotel or similar)

fields.title: Antananarivo to Morondava - Baobab Avenue
fields.description: Morning flight to Morondava (1 hour). Drive to the famous Avenue of the Baobabs. Walk among the 800-year-old Adansonia grandidieri baobabs at sunset. Watch the trees turn orange and purple.
fields.activities: Domestic flight, Baobab Avenue sunset walk, Photography

fields.title: Kirindy Forest - Lemurs & Fossa
fields.description: Morning visit to Kirindy Forest Reserve. See Madagascar's largest predator - the fossa (looks like a cougar). Spot Verreaux's sifaka (dancing lemur) and red-fronted lemurs. Night walk to see mouse lemurs (smallest primate in the world).
fields.activities: Kirindy Forest walk, Fossa viewing, Lemur spotting, Night walk

fields.title: Morondava to Antananarivo - Return Flight
fields.description: Morning sunrise at the Avenue of the Baobabs (different orientation). Visit a local fishing village. Flight back to Antananarivo (1 hour). Afternoon explore the upper town - Queen's Palace (Rova) and the Andafiavaratra Palace.
fields.activities: Sunrise baobab photos, Village visit, Palace tour

fields.title: Antananarivo to Nosy Be - Island Escape
fields.description: Morning flight to Nosy Be (2 hours) - Madagascar's premier beach destination. Transfer to your beach resort on the island. Afternoon beach relaxation or explore Hell-Ville town.
fields.activities: Domestic flight, Beach check-in, Island orientation
fields.accommodation: Beach resort in Nosy Be (Nosy Be Lodge or similar)

fields.title: Nosy Be - Lokobe Forest Reserve
fields.description: Morning boat trip to Lokobe Forest Reserve (on Nosy Be). Trek through the rainforest to see the endangered black lemur and Nosy Be sportive lemur. Afternoon visit to Nosy Komba (Lemur Island) to see friendly lemurs.
fields.activities: Boat trip, Rainforest trek, Lemur feeding, Photography

fields.title: Nosy Be - Snorkeling & Island Tour
fields.description: Full day boat excursion to Nosy Tanikely (marine reserve). Snorkel in crystal clear waters among colorful coral reefs and tropical fish. Visit the lighthouse for panoramic views. Optional whale shark snorkeling (Oct-Dec).
fields.activities: Snorkeling, Coral reef exploration, Marine life viewing

fields.title: Nosy Be to Antananarivo - Departure
fields.description: Morning beach relaxation. Flight back to Antananarivo. Connect to your international departure flight from Ivato International Airport.
fields.activities: Beach morning, Domestic flight, International departure

fields.title: Arrival in Dubai - City of Gold
fields.description: Arrive at Dubai International Airport (DXB). Meet your guide and transfer to your hotel. Evening visit to Dubai Marina walk. Dinner at a restaurant with Burj Al Arab views.
fields.activities: Airport transfer, Marina walk, City lights viewing
fields.accommodation: 5-star hotel in Dubai (JW Marriott Marquis or similar)

fields.title: Dubai - Burj Khalifa & The Dubai Mall
fields.description: Visit Burj Khalifa (At The Top Sky observation deck on 148th floor). See the Dubai Fountain show. Afternoon explore The Dubai Mall (largest mall in the world). Visit Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo. Evening light show at Burj Khalifa.
fields.activities: Burj Khalifa ascent, Dubai Mall shopping, Fountain show, Aquarium

fields.title: Desert Safari - Dune Bashing & Bedouin Camp
fields.description: Afternoon desert safari (4:00 PM - 9:00 PM). Dune bashing in 4x4 vehicles. Camel riding and sandboarding. Visit a Bedouin camp for henna painting, shisha, and falconry. BBQ dinner and belly dancing show. Stargazing in the desert.
fields.activities: Dune bashing, Camel ride, Sandboarding, Bedouin dinner, Entertainment

fields.title: Dubai - Old & New Dubai
fields.description: Morning visit to Old Dubai - Dubai Creek (abra boat ride), Gold Souk, Spice Souk, and Al Fahidi Historical District (wind tower architecture). Afternoon visit to Palm Jumeirah and Atlantis The Palm (monorail ride). Visit The Pointe for fountain show.
fields.activities: Old Dubai walking tour, Souk shopping, Palm Jumeirah monorail

fields.title: Dubai Departure - Last Luxury
fields.description: Morning visit to Burj Al Arab for photos (Jumeirah Beach). Last chance shopping at Mall of the Emirates (ski slope inside mall) or Souk Madinat Jumeirah. Transfer to Dubai International Airport for departure.
fields.activities: Beach photos, Shopping, Airport transfer

fields.title: Arrival in Istanbul - Two Continents
fields.description: Arrive at Istanbul Airport (IST). Transfer to your hotel in Sultanahmet (old city). Evening walk through Sultanahmet Square to see Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque lit up.
fields.activities: Airport transfer, Historic square walk, Orientation

fields.title: Istanbul - Hagia Sophia & Blue Mosque
fields.description: Morning visit Hagia Sophia (former Byzantine church/mosque/museum). Visit Blue Mosque (active mosque with blue Iznik tiles). Afternoon Topkapi Palace (Ottoman palace with harem and holy relics). Visit the Basilica Cistern (underground water reservoir).
fields.activities: Hagia Sophia tour, Blue Mosque visit, Palace museum, Underground cistern

fields.title: Istanbul - Grand Bazaar & Bosphorus
fields.description: Morning visit to Grand Bazaar (4,000 shops) and Spice Bazaar. Afternoon Bosphorus cruise (2 hours) between Europe and Asia. See Rumeli Fortress and Ottoman palaces. Visit the Egyptian Bazaar for spices and Turkish delight.
fields.activities: Market shopping, Bosphorus boat cruise, Asian side visit

fields.title: Istanbul to Cappadocia - Fairy Chimneys
fields.description: Morning flight to Kayseri Airport (ASR) or Nevşehir (NAV) (1.5 hours). Transfer to Cappadocia (45 minutes). Visit the Göreme Open Air Museum (rock-cut churches). Walk through Love Valley with fairy chimneys.
fields.activities: Domestic flight, Göreme churches, Fairy chimney photography
fields.accommodation: Cave hotel in Cappadocia (Museum Hotel or similar)

fields.title: Cappadocia - Hot Air Balloon Sunrise
fields.description: 4:30 AM hot air balloon ride over fairy chimneys (included). Sunrise views of 1,000 balloons in the air. Afternoon underground city tour (Derinkuyu or Kaymaklı - 8 levels deep). Visit Pigeon Valley for photos.
fields.activities: Hot air balloon flight, Underground city exploration, Valley walk

fields.title: Cappadocia - Pottery & Carpets
fields.description: Morning visit to Avanos for pottery making demonstration (using red clay from Kızılırmak River). Visit a Turkish carpet workshop to see silk carpet weaving. Afternoon sunset hike in Rose Valley. Evening Turkish night show with whirling dervishes.
fields.activities: Pottery workshop, Carpet weaving, Valley sunset hike, Cultural show

fields.title: Cappadocia to Istanbul - Departure
fields.description: Morning visit to Uçhisar Castle (rock fortress with panoramic views). Final fairy chimney photo. Flight back to Istanbul. Connect to international departure flight from Istanbul Airport.
fields.activities: Castle climb, Final photos, Domestic flight

fields.title: Arrival in Bangkok - City of Angels
fields.description: Arrive at Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK). Transfer to your hotel. Evening visit to Khao San Road (backpacker street) for street food and nightlife.
fields.activities: Airport transfer, Street food tasting

fields.title: Bangkok - Grand Palace & Temples
fields.description: Visit the Grand Palace and Wat Phra Kaew (Emerald Buddha). See Wat Pho (Reclining Buddha - 46m long). Take a longtail boat through Bangkok's canals (khlongs). Afternoon Wat Arun (Temple of Dawn) at sunset.
fields.activities: Palace tour, Reclining Buddha, Boat ride, Temple climb

fields.title: Bangkok - Floating Markets & Train Market
fields.description: Drive to Damnoen Saduak Floating Market (2 hours). Shop from boats selling food and souvenirs. Visit Mae Klong Railway Market - where a train passes through the market every day. Afternoon Chatuchak Weekend Market (only weekends).
fields.activities: Floating market boat ride, Train market experience, Mega market shopping

fields.title: Bangkok to Phuket - Beach Paradise
fields.description: Morning flight to Phuket International Airport (HKT) (1.5 hours). Transfer to your beach resort. Afternoon relax on Patong Beach or Kata Beach. Evening Bangla Road walking street for nightlife.
fields.activities: Domestic flight, Beach arrival, Phuket orientation
fields.accommodation: Beach resort in Phuket (Patong or Kata area)

fields.title: Phuket - Phi Phi Islands Tour
fields.description: Full day speedboat tour to Phi Phi Islands (2 hours each way). Visit Maya Bay (The Beach movie location), Pileh Lagoon (emerald water), and Viking Cave. Snorkel with colorful fish. Monkey Beach stop. Lunch on Phi Phi Don.
fields.activities: Speedboat ride, Island hopping, Snorkeling, Beach time

fields.title: Phuket - Big Buddha & Phang Nga Bay
fields.description: Morning visit to Big Buddha (45m tall marble statue on Nakkerd Hill). Visit Wat Chalong temple. Afternoon Phang Nga Bay tour (James Bond Island - Khao Phing Kan). Sea canoeing through limestone caves and hongs (collapsed cave roofs).
fields.activities: Big Buddha climb, Temple visit, Bay tour, Sea canoeing

fields.title: Phuket - Elephant Sanctuary
fields.description: Morning visit to Phuket Elephant Sanctuary (ethical rescue center). Feed, walk with, and bathe rescued elephants (no riding). Learn about elephant conservation. Afternoon free at resort - massage or spa treatment.
fields.activities: Elephant feeding and bathing, Spa time

fields.title: Phuket to Bangkok - Departure
fields.description: Morning beach time or souvenir shopping at Jungceylon Mall. Flight back to Bangkok. Connect to international departure flight from Suvarnabhumi Airport.
fields.activities: Beach morning, Shopping, Domestic flight

fields.title: Arrival in Delhi - Capital City
fields.description: Arrive at Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL). Transfer to your hotel. Evening visit to Connaught Place for shopping and dining.
fields.activities: Airport transfer, City orientation
fields.accommodation: 5-star hotel in Delhi (The Leela or similar)

fields.title: Delhi - Old & New City
fields.description: Morning Old Delhi tour - visit Jama Masjid (India's largest mosque), take a rickshaw ride through Chandni Chowk, visit the Red Fort (Lal Qila). Afternoon New Delhi - drive past India Gate, Parliament House, and Rashtrapati Bhavan (President's House). Visit Qutub Minar.
fields.activities: Rickshaw ride, Fort visit, Monument photography

fields.title: Delhi to Agra - Taj Mahal at Sunset
fields.description: Drive to Agra (3.5 hours via Yamuna Expressway). Check into hotel. Afternoon visit Taj Mahal at sunset (built by Shah Jahan for Mumtaz Mahal). See the white marble change colors. Evening free for shopping.
fields.activities: Scenic drive, Taj Mahal sunset tour, Photography
fields.accommodation: 5-star hotel in Agra (The Oberoi Amarvilas or similar)

fields.title: Agra - Taj Mahal Sunrise & Agra Fort
fields.description: 5:30 AM sunrise visit to Taj Mahal (best time for photos and less crowds). Return to hotel for breakfast. Visit Agra Fort (UNESCO site where Shah Jahan was imprisoned). See Itmad-ud-Daulah (Baby Taj). Drive to Jaipur (4 hours).
fields.activities: Sunrise Taj Mahal, Fort exploration, Scenic drive
fields.accommodation: Heritage hotel in Jaipur (Rambagh Palace or similar)

fields.title: Jaipur - Amber Fort & City Palace
fields.description: Morning visit to Amber Fort (elephant ride or jeep up the hill). See Sheesh Mahal (Mirror Palace). Afternoon City Palace (still home to the royal family). Visit Jantar Mantar (ancient astronomical observatory). Evening Bollywood movie at Raj Mandir Cinema.
fields.activities: Fort climb, Palace tour, Observatory visit

fields.title: Jaipur - Hawa Mahal & Blue City
fields.description: Visit Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds) - photo stop. Drive through Jaipur's "Blue City". Visit Jal Mahal (Water Palace). Afternoon craft shopping - block printing, blue pottery, and gemstones. Visit Chokhi Dhani village resort for Rajasthani dinner and folk dancing.
fields.activities: Palace photos, Craft shopping, Cultural dinner

fields.title: Jaipur to Delhi - Departure
fields.description: Morning drive back to Delhi (5 hours). Last chance souvenir shopping at Dilli Haat (craft market). Transfer to Indira Gandhi International Airport for departure.
fields.activities: Scenic return, Craft market shopping, Airport transfer

fields.title: Arrival in Paris - City of Light
fields.description: Arrive at Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG). Transfer to your hotel. Evening Seine River cruise to see illuminated monuments.
fields.activities: Airport transfer, Seine cruise, City lights
fields.accommodation: 4-star hotel in Paris (Le Meurice or similar)

fields.title: Paris - Eiffel Tower & Louvre
fields.description: Morning visit to Eiffel Tower (2nd floor - skip the line). See Trocadéro for best photos. Afternoon Louvre Museum (guided tour to see Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo). Walk through Tuileries Garden.
fields.activities: Eiffel Tower ascent, Museum tour, Garden walk

fields.title: Paris - Montmartre & Notre Dame
fields.description: Visit Montmartre - Sacré-Cœur Basilica, Place du Tertre (artist square), and Moulin Rouge. Visit Notre-Dame Cathedral (exterior) and Sainte-Chapelle (stained glass windows). Evening optional cabaret show (Moulin Rouge or Lido).
fields.activities: Montmartre walking tour, Cathedral visit, Art square

fields.title: Paris to Rome - Flight to Eternal City
fields.description: Morning visit to Arc de Triomphe (climb for views) and Champs-Élysées. Afternoon flight to Rome (2 hours). Transfer to hotel. Evening walk to Trevi Fountain (throw a coin).
fields.activities: Arc climb, Champs-Élysées walk, Domestic flight
fields.accommodation: 4-star hotel in Rome (Hotel Artemide or similar)

fields.title: Rome - Colosseum & Roman Forum
fields.description: Morning Colosseum (skip the line - Underground & Arena access). Visit Roman Forum (political center of ancient Rome) and Palatine Hill. Afternoon Capitoline Museums (oldest museum in the world).
fields.activities: Colosseum tour, Forum walk, Museum visit

fields.title: Vatican City - St. Peter's & Sistine Chapel
fields.description: Morning Vatican Museums (skip the line) - see Sistine Chapel (Michelangelo's ceiling). Visit St. Peter's Basilica (largest church in the world) and climb to the dome. See the Papal Swiss Guard.
