fields.activities: Vatican tour, Sistine Chapel viewing, Dome climb

fields.title: Rome - Trastevere & Borghese Gallery
fields.description: Morning Borghese Gallery (Bernini sculptures and Caravaggio paintings - reservation required). Afternoon Trastevere neighborhood walking tour (medieval streets, ivy-covered buildings). Visit Santa Maria in Trastevere church.
fields.activities: Art gallery tour, Medieval neighborhood walk

fields.title: Rome to Paris - Departure
fields.description: Morning visit to Piazza Navona (Bernini fountains) and Pantheon. Last chance shopping at Spanish Steps. Flight back to Paris (2 hours). Connect to international departure flight from Charles de Gaulle Airport.
fields.activities: Fountain viewing, Shopping, Flights

fields.title: Embarkation in Mombasa - Kenya Coast
fields.description: Arrive at Mombasa Cruise Terminal. Board your luxury cruise ship (MSC or similar). Ship departs at 6:00 PM. Welcome aboard dinner.
fields.activities: Boarding, Ship orientation, Welcome dinner

fields.title: At Sea - Indian Ocean Sailing
fields.description: Day at sea enjoying ship amenities - swimming pools, spa, casino, theater shows, cooking classes, wine tasting. Captain's welcome gala dinner.
fields.activities: Pool, Spa treatments, Entertainment shows, Formal dinner

fields.title: Zanzibar - Stone Town & Spice Tour
fields.description: Arrive at Zanzibar Port (8:00 AM). Shore excursion to Stone Town, spice plantations, and Forodhani Gardens. Return to ship by 5:00 PM. Sail to Mauritius.
fields.activities: Stone Town walking tour, Spice tour, Local markets

fields.title: At Sea - Relaxation Day
fields.description: Relaxing day at sea. Optional activities: yoga classes, art auctions, trivia contests, Latin dance lessons, poolside movies.
fields.activities: Ship activities, Relaxation

fields.title: Mauritius - Beaches & Volcanic Craters
fields.description: Arrive at Port Louis, Mauritius (7:00 AM). Shore excursion to Pamplemousses Botanical Garden, Trou aux Cerfs (volcanic crater), and Grand Baie beaches. Depart at 6:00 PM.
fields.activities: Botanical garden tour, Crater viewpoint, Beach time

fields.title: At Sea - Final Sea Day
fields.description: Final day at sea. Enjoy last chance for spa treatments, duty-free shopping, water slides, and casino. Farewell gala dinner.
fields.activities: Ship amenities, Shopping, Farewell dinner

fields.title: Seychelles - Mahé Island
fields.description: Arrive at Port Victoria, Mahé (8:00 AM). Shore excursion to Morne Seychellois National Park, Beau Vallon Beach, and Victoria Market. Disembarkation.
fields.activities: National park walk, Beach time, Market shopping

fields.title: Seychelles to Mombasa - Departure
fields.description: Free morning in Seychelles. Afternoon flight back to Mombasa (3 hours). Connect to international departure or extend stay.
fields.activities: Flight, Airport transfer

fields.title: Embarkation Barcelona - Spain Departure
fields.description: Arrive at Barcelona Cruise Port. Board premium cruise ship. Evening departure at 6:00 PM.
fields.activities: Embarkation, Ship tour

fields.title: At Sea - Mediterranean to Atlantic
fields.description: Cross the Strait of Gibraltar. Day at sea with ship amenities.
fields.activities: Ship activities

fields.title: Casablanca, Morocco - Hassan II Mosque
fields.description: Arrive at Casablanca Port. Shore excursion to Hassan II Mosque (largest mosque in Africa). Visit Rick's Cafe and Habous Market.
fields.activities: Mosque tour, Market visit, Movie location

fields.title: At Sea - Sail to West Africa
fields.description: Day at sea crossing the Tropic of Cancer. Themed parties and entertainment.
fields.activities: Onboard activities

fields.title: Dakar, Senegal - Goree Island
fields.description: Arrive at Dakar Port. Shore excursion to Goree Island (Door of No Return) and African Renaissance Monument.
fields.activities: Island tour, Monument visit

fields.title: At Sea - Crossing Equator
fields.description: Cross the Equator - King Neptune ceremony. Day at sea.
fields.activities: Equator crossing celebration

fields.title: At Sea - Sail to South Africa
fields.description: Second sea day heading south. Wine tasting and culinary workshops.
fields.activities: Workshops, Tastings

fields.title: At Sea - Final Sea Day
fields.description: Final day at sea before South Africa. Prepare for safari excursions.
fields.activities: Safari briefing

fields.title: Cape Town, South Africa - Table Mountain
fields.description: Arrive at Cape Town Port. Shore excursion to Table Mountain, V&A Waterfront, and Robben Island (optional).
fields.activities: Mountain cable car, Waterfront

fields.title: Cape Town - Cape Peninsula
fields.description: Full day shore excursion to Cape of Good Hope, Boulders Beach penguins, and Chapman's Peak Drive.
fields.activities: Cape Point, Penguin viewing

fields.title: Cape Town - Winelands
fields.description: Excursion to Stellenbosch wine region. Wine tastings at 3 estates.
fields.activities: Wine tasting

fields.title: Disembarkation Cape Town
fields.description: Disembark cruise ship. Transfer to Cape Town International Airport for departure.
fields.activities: Airport transfer

fields.title: Luxor - Embarkation & East Bank
fields.description: Arrive at Luxor. Embark 5-star Nile cruise ship. Afternoon visit Karnak Temple and Luxor Temple illuminated at night.
fields.activities: Temple tours, Embarkation

fields.title: West Bank - Valley of Kings
fields.description: Visit Valley of Kings, Temple of Hatshepsut, and Colossi of Memnon. Sail to Edfu.
fields.activities: Tomb exploration

fields.title: Edfu & Kom Ombo - Temple Tour
fields.description: Visit Temple of Edfu. Sail to Kom Ombo. Afternoon visit Kom Ombo Temple (double temple). Sail to Aswan.
fields.activities: Temple tours

fields.title: Aswan - Philae Temple & High Dam
fields.description: Visit High Dam, Philae Temple (motorboat), and Unfinished Obelisk. Optional Abu Simbel tour.
fields.activities: Temple tours, Dam visit

fields.title: Aswan - Disembarkation
fields.description: Disembark cruise. Morning Nubian Village visit. Transfer to Aswan Airport.
fields.activities: Village tour

fields.title: Embarkation Cape Town
fields.description: Board cruise ship in Cape Town. Sail along Table Bay.
fields.activities: Embarkation

fields.title: At Sea - Garden Route Views
fields.description: Sail along the Garden Route. See coastal mountains from the ship.
fields.activities: Scenic sailing

fields.title: Port Elizabeth - Addo Elephant
fields.description: Arrive at Port Elizabeth. Shore excursion to Addo Elephant National Park.
fields.activities: Elephant viewing, Game drive

fields.title: At Sea - Indian Ocean Sailing
fields.description: Day at sea. Enjoy ship amenities - spa, pool, and entertainment.
fields.activities: Ship activities

fields.title: East London - Buffalo City
fields.description: Arrive at East London. Visit East London Museum (coelacanth fish) and Nahoon Estuary Nature Reserve.
fields.activities: Museum tour, Nature walk

fields.title: Durban - Golden Mile
fields.description: Arrive at Durban Port. Shore excursion to uShaka Marine World, Moses Mabhida Stadium, and Victoria Street Market.
fields.activities: Aquarium visit, Stadium climb, Market shopping

fields.title: Durban - Disembarkation
fields.description: Disembark cruise ship in Durban. Transfer to King Shaka International Airport for departure.
fields.activities: Airport transfer

fields.title: Embarkation Dakar, Senegal
fields.description: Board cruise ship in Dakar Port. Evening departure along Cape Verde Peninsula.
fields.activities: Embarkation, Ship tour

fields.title: At Sea - Gambia River
fields.description: Sail past Gambia River. Day at sea with cultural presentations about West Africa.
fields.activities: Cultural lectures

fields.title: Abidjan, Ivory Coast - Modern Architecture
fields.description: Arrive at Abidjan Port. Shore excursion to St. Paul's Cathedral, Banco National Park, and Treichville Market.
fields.activities: Cathedral visit, Market tour

fields.title: At Sea - Gulf of Guinea
fields.description: Cross the Gulf of Guinea. Day at sea with African cooking classes.
fields.activities: Cooking classes

fields.title: Takoradi, Ghana - Cape Coast Castles
fields.description: Arrive at Takoradi Port. Shore excursion to Cape Coast Castle, Elmina Castle, and Kakum Canopy Walkway.
fields.activities: Castle tours, Canopy walk

fields.title: Takoradi - Local Markets
fields.description: Second day in Takoradi. Visit local markets, traditional fishing villages, and craft centers.
fields.activities: Market shopping, Village visits

fields.title: At Sea - Final Sea Day
fields.description: Final day at sea. Enjoy farewell gala dinner and onboard entertainment.
fields.activities: Farewell dinner

fields.title: Accra, Ghana - Independence Square
fields.description: Arrive at Tema Port (Accra). Shore excursion to Independence Square, Kwame Nkrumah Memorial, and Makola Market.
fields.activities: Monument visits, Market tour

fields.title: Accra - Disembarkation
fields.description: Disembark cruise ship. Transfer to Kotoka International Airport for departure.
fields.activities: Airport transfer

fields.name: Safari Edge Camp

fields.name: Stone Town Heritage Suite
fields.description: Beautiful studio in the heart of Stone Town. Authentic Zanzibari architecture with modern amenities and rich cultural atmosphere.

fields.name: Karen Luxury Loft
fields.description: Modern loft in Nairobi's upscale Karen neighborhood. Close to Giraffe Centre and Sheldrick Wildlife Trust. Perfect for business travelers.

fields.name: Nyali Beach Mansion
fields.description: Spacious beachfront mansion with 4 bedrooms, private pool, and stunning Indian Ocean views. Ideal for large groups and special occasions.

fields.name: Mount Meru View Lodge
fields.description: Cozy lodge with spectacular views of Mount Meru. Gateway to Serengeti and Ngorongoro safaris. Features local architecture and warm hospitality.

fields.description: Modern apartment in Kigali's business district. Panoramic city views, rooftop pool, and convenient access to business centers.

fields.name: Amboseli Safari Lodge
